preprocessed.scope: temporary quantization intermediate; SHA and metadata retained in this report, bytes not published

quality_evaluation.ground_truth_policy: count every YOLO TXT box; VOC difficult/truncated flags are not represented
quality_evaluation.label_format: YOLO normalized class_id center_x center_y width height

graph_audit.classification_note: QDQ preserves Conv op_type; a Conv is classified as quantized only when its activation and INT8 per-channel weight Q/DQ structure and output QuantizeLinear are present. Protocol-excluded Conv nodes are classified separately as intentional_unquantized and must retain a direct FP32 weight initializer.

limitations: This card proves Python ONNX checker/session legality and QDQ graph structure; the separate C++ Runtime gate remains required.
Calibration uses exactly 180 frozen images and does not imply task-quality acceptance on the labeled evaluation split.
The preprocessed ONNX is a temporary lineage intermediate and is reproducible only with the pinned tool/environment/protocol.
Python uses CPUExecutionProvider explicitly even when the wheel also exposes CUDA or TensorRT providers.

quantization.api_signature: (model_input: Union[str, pathlib.Path, onnx.onnx_ml_pb2.ModelProto], model_output: Union[str, pathlib.Path], calibration_data_reader: onnxruntime.quantization.calibrate.CalibrationDataReader, quant_format=<QuantFormat.QDQ: 1>, op_types_to_quantize=None, per_channel=False, reduce_range=False, activation_type=<QuantType.QInt8: 0>, weight_type=<QuantType.QInt8: 0>, nodes_to_quantize=None, nodes_to_exclude=None, use_external_data_format=False, calibrate_method=<CalibrationMethod.MinMax: 0>, extra_options=None)
quantization.calibration_reader: one contiguous float32 NCHW tensor per call
